Round 2 (2026-09-01): P'Earth requested Refresh button + Delete row — both explicit scope expansions beyond MVP spec §7.2/§14 ("MVP explicitly excludes editing or deleting a row"), confirmed and approved by P'Earth before starting. Delete uses real Sheets deleteRow() (not soft-delete) — every row-number-based id downstream of a delete is invalidated, so the frontend must always refetch the full list after a successful delete rather than optimistically removing just one row locally.

Round 2 QA: 1 minor finding (delete button not disabled during its own pending request, theoretical double-click race on real backend) — fixed via per-row deletingId state, re-verified RESOLVED by แพร on 2026-09-01.
